input_types: Two bounded caller-supplied evidence snapshots for the same task_id and claim_id, each with exact as-of reference/UTC time, scope and applicability digests, declared claim state/change reason, evaluator/update/stopping policy identities, acquisition-dependence mode, and up to 200 evidence records.
required_outputs: Exact added, absent-from-candidate, retained, changed, and unresolved evidence record IDs; declared withdrawal/retraction transitions; and source-family counts.
Predecessor/as-of binding plus scope, applicability, task-revision, claim-state, evaluator, update/stopping-policy, and acquisition-dependence deltas.
COMPARABLE_AS_DECLARED or COMPARISON_UNKNOWN with explicit EXPLICIT_NO_CHANGE/NO_CHANGE_NOT_ESTABLISHED distinction and execution_authorized=false.
